in_arabic.name: تصديقات
in_arabic.meaning: تأكيد و تصديق على شئ ما

in_urdu.name: تصدیقات
in_urdu.long_meaning: تصدیقات کا مطلب ہے تصدیق کرنا، تائید کرنا، یا کسی بات کو سچ 인정 کرنا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ سچائی اور ایمان کی مضبوطی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ عربی زبان میں 'صدق' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سچ یا راستبازی

in_hindi.name: तसदीक़ात
in_hindi.long_meaning: तसदीक़ात नाम का अर्थ है सच्चाई को स्वीकार करना और उसकी पुष्टि करना। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है, क्योंकि यह सच्चाई और विश्वास की दृढ़ता को दर्शाता है। यह नाम उन गुणों को बढ़ावा देता है जो मुस्लिम समुदाय में अत्यधिक मूल्यवान हैं

in_pashto.name: تصديقات
in_pashto.meaning: د یو شي تصديق، د سچ پخپله منل
in_pashto.long_meaning: تصديقات د تصديق جمع دی، په پښتو کې دا د سچ منلو او يا د يو شي تصديق کولو مانا لري. دا نوم په افغانستان کې د پښتنو په ميان کې د سچايي او صداقت د ارزښتونو د ټینګښت څرګندونکی دی

in_english.name: Tasdiqat
in_english.meaning: Confirmation, verification, or affirmation of truth
in_english.long_meaning: The name Tasdiqat originates from the Arabic root 'صدق' (s-d-q), which means 'to tell the truth' or 'to confirm'. In Islamic tradition, Tasdiqat signifies the act of affirming or verifying the truth, especially in relation to faith and divine revelation. This name reflects a strong commitment to honesty and integrity, values highly regarded in Muslim cultures worldwide. Historically, names like Tasdiqat have been used to inspire virtues such as sincerity and trustworthiness

data.spiritual_significance: Tasdiqat carries immense spiritual significance for Muslims. In the Islamic tradition, the act of giving Tasdeeq, or confirmation, symbolizes the submission of one's faith in Allah and the quest for divine guidance. It underlines the importance of acknowledging and recognizing the blessings bestowed upon us by Allah and making constant efforts to live in accordance with His will. Additionally, Tasdiqat represents the concept of seeking affirmation from Allah and auditing one's actions and intentions in life, to strive towards becoming a better human being - in essence, conducting a self-appraisal, and asking for Allah's forgiveness and approval in every aspect. This profound spiritual meaning encourages us to continue on the path of self-improvement, seeking the approval and blessings of Allah in all our endeavors.
